fields.summary_ko.0: Goldman Sachs lowered Samsung Electronics' target price from KRW 500,000 to KRW 350,000 (30% reduction) and SK Hynix from KRW 3.5 million to KRW 2 million (43% downgrade), forecasting weaker semiconductor boom in 2028.
fields.summary_ko.1: DRAM supply shortage ratio in 2028 is expected to narrow from 5.1% to 1.2%, with Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix's generic DRAM prices anticipated to decline by 20% and 19% respectively.
